redfin.remarks: OCEAN VIEW CONTEMPORARY TOWNHOME w/ SOARING 18' CEILINGS in this TOTALLY CUSTOMIZED 3 bedrooms & 2 1/2 bath home. Just a few short blocks to shops, restaurants, and the surf. A PERFECT LOCATION! Queen's Neck OCEAN VIEW from the top floor! One of only 3 units with DIRECT GARAGE ACCESS. Wake up and sip your coffee in Sunny, ENCLOSED PATIO outside the QUIET MASTER BEDROOM with a newly installed FIREPLACE, custom cabinets, a Murphy Bed, & 2 walk-in closets. Feel like you are on vacation in a 5-star resort with the MASTER BATH's sauna, heated towel rack & heated stone floors. The custom kitchen features 3-year-old Viking stainless steel appliances, 3-year-old custom cabinets, and granite countertops. TONS OF STORAGE. .. custom cabinets in almost every room including multiple racks in the garage. This home also features beautiful, light oak floors- just refinished & a porcelain tile formal entry. Keep warm in the winter in the newly installed LIVINGROOM FIREPLACE. Check out the pier and the surf from the ocean-view deck accessed from beautiful high-end Pella doors. The large, quiet ceiling fans, stone floors & plantation shutters keep temperatures cool. Tankless water heater. Past MLS square footage at 1689, owner taped it at 1550. Buyer to verify. Seller converted the loft into a bedroom w/ walk-in closet. Pet-friendly complex with good cash reserves. You usually have to pay more to live this close to downtown! Life in downtown MANHATTAN BEACH is FUN! What are you waiting for!
